name: Mome! Chichi Shimai Katei Kyoushi 11nin
original_name: もめっ！乳姉妹かていきょうし11人
source:
Main character is a student who is honest about his desires - he practices voyeurism and eavesdropping targeting the neighboring girls. One day a mysterious meteorite arrives and destroys the house where 11 girls were living. Protagonist suggests his own house as a temporary solution. But just eavesdropping is not enough already. He organizes private tutorship in order to be left with individual girls alone.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
身为学生的男主角向来忠于自身欲望——平日里总爱对隔壁邻家女孩实施偷窥与窃听。某天，一颗神秘陨石从天而降，把隔壁11名姐妹居住的房子砸成了废墟，男主角顺水推舟提议让她们暂住进自己家里。然而光靠偷听早已无法满足他的胃口；为了能与女孩们逐一独处，他干脆办起了“一对一私人家庭教师辅导课”。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
